text:
maria: quick q — thoughts on rolling a lightweight runtime "probe adapter" that lets /v6 clients hit the v8 handlers without forcing client updates? we see a lot of managed customers on older SDKs and want minimal churn.
ajay: do you mean header sniff + in-flight transform at the runtime layer, or a separate inbound proxy that rewrites requests?
maria: prefer header sniff + transform in runtime so we avoid extra hop. idea: if no `X-RW-Client-Version` header, treat as legacy and apply shim. main concerns are perf and tracing propagation.
kevin: perf should be fine if transform is O(1) and we cache mapping rules. biggest risk is when mappings touch KV cache keys or model args — that can change caching behavior. we should ensure transforms are cache-preserving where possible.
lisa: telemetry requirement: tag any request that hits the shim with `x-rw-compat-shim: v6->v8` in the response and emit `compat.shim.hit` metric. need to capture counts + sample payload diffs for regressions.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started on dedicated-dev cluster (canary=5% traffic) :rocket:
ajay: semantics question — v6 allowed `stop_sequences` array, v8 has `filters` object. shim should translate common fields 1:1 but also log mismatches. define explicit fallback when both fields are present or when conversion is ambiguous.
maria: agreed. plan to implement minimal conversion rules and return non-blocking validation hints in the response body with code `compat_mismatch` (so we don't break traffic).
kevin: also add a per-tenant opt-out flag. some enterprise customers require strict contract enforcement, so we need `tenant.compat_shim=false` toggle. rollout plan: enable shim globally for 30 days, collect telemetry, then notify customers and default-off post-window for tenants that opt-out.
lisa: test matrix notes — unit tests for mappings, e2e through runtime with minority of traffic, and a load run at ~50k RPS to verify tail latency. alert if p99 increases > 20ms or > 120ms absolute.
ajay: implementation split: runtime: header detector + transform registry; platform: tenant flag + telemetry ingestion; docs: migration guide + SDK snippets. I'll own runtime PR.
maria: I'll file an RFC follow-up with the mapping table, error codes, and rollout timeline. owners: @ajay/runtime, @kevin/platform, @lisa/docs. timeline: PRs in two weeks, canary next Wed.
kevin: :+1: also instrument `compat.shim.failures` and `compat.shim.transform_time_ms` for alerted thresholds.
lisa: :eyes: will add a doc stub and example snippets for Node/Python SDKs.
maria: thanks — unless anyone objects I'll start the RFC addendum and ticket the work.
